meta.title: [alpha_factory] enhance browser size workflow caches
meta.body_summary: Enhance browser size CI workflow by reusing built-in pip and npm caches via actions/setup-python and actions/setup-node.

perf_labels.notes: Self-merged tiny CI caching change with zero review; narrative claim only, no performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 25 changed lines across 3 files, this is a very small edit by absolute volume. As a trivial CI caching improvement, it was merged instantly without any review, consistent with a low-risk configuration change.

review_details.concern_detail: No review or comment text available in the dataset; the PR was self-merged by the maintainer immediately.
review_details.performance_claim: Improve browser size workflow speed by caching pip and npm dependencies.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Simple CI caching addition using standard actions; merged without review, indicating low friction for this type of build-time optimization.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance measurements; the PR only claims caching improvement without before/after numbers.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions observed; no review cycle.

core_change_summary.description: In .github/workflows/size-check.yml, replaced manual cache steps with actions/setup-python@v4 (cache: 'pip') and actions/setup-node@v3 (cache: 'npm'); updated README and CHANGELOG to mention new caching approach.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Documentation updates reflect the caching improvement.
change_trajectory: Single commit adding built-in pip/npm caching to workflow, removing previous manual steps.

collaboration_trajectory: PR created and immediately merged by the same user without any review or comment.
